messages:
Maya (she/her): Quick fun question — imagine you have a physical 'Do Not Disturb' button that, when pressed, pauses one mundane task in your life for exactly 1 hour. What task do you pause? (examples: laundry folding, inbox, commuting, dishes)
Anton: Laundry folding. My brain melts into a pile of socks every week. :sweat_smile: (reaction :laughing:)
Sam G.: Commuting for sure. An hour of 'teleport me to my desk' would make mornings legendary. :raised_hands:
Devon: Spam and promo emails. Full stop. Auto-archive anything that smells like "you've won" for 1 hour. :pray:
Liu: Dishes. One hour of absolute dish-free bliss = peak productivity at home. :plate_with_cutlery:
Maya (she/her): Love these. If you could set a schedule (like once a week), would you use it weekly or keep it as an emergency-only thing?
Anton: Weekly. Hygiene of the apartment needs maintenance but also occasional miracles. :thumbsup:
Sam G.: Emergency-only. Save it for the days everything piles up. Rare + powerful.
Devon: Scheduled mornings would be nice for inbox pause so I can actually focus on deep work without FOMO.
Liu: Emergency. I hoard my cheats.
OpsBot: Reminder: scheduled pauses may affect recurring background tasks (laundry reminders, subscriptions) — toggle override in settings. :robot_face:
Maya (she/her): This thread has convinced me to start a petition for a real button. Anyone want to add their vote: weekly vs emergency? Reply with 'weekly' or 'emergency'.
Anton: weekly
Sam G.: emergency
Devon: weekly
Liu: emergency
Maya (she/her): Votes noted. Results so far — 2 weekly, 2 emergency, 1 undecided (me). :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Maya (she/her): Bonus: what sound should the button make when pressed? Short answers only.
Anton: Retro vending machine 'ka-ching'
Sam G.: Soft chime, like a library bell
Devon: Robot boop (classic)
Liu: Bubble pop
Maya (she/her): Great. Thanks all — this made my commute more fun. :sparkles:
